title: Senior AWS Platform Engineer
description: At Luscii, we are creating space for care by building digital health applications that help people manage their health. Applications such as the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with healthcare professionals around the world, we build technology that helps users receive the right care in the right place. Millions of people rely on our products every month, and behind every reliable healthcare experience is a cloud platform that simply works. As engineer working on our apps, you will play a vital role in modernising the cloud platform that powers the platform, creating a more reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide. OMRON Connect is one of the largest digital health platforms in our ecosystem, connecting millions of users with their healthcare data through OMRON devices. Much of the platform has grown over many years and was partly built by external partners. Today, we're investing heavily in bringing that knowledge, ownership and technical excellence in-house. This is not about replacing everything overnight. It is about making thoughtful engineering decisions, modernising step by step, and building a cloud platform that gives our engineering teams the foundations, tooling and confidence they need to deliver safely and independently. Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of a platform serving several million monthly active users across the world. You will help shape our cloud and engineering standards, introduce modern practices where they genuinely add value, and make Infrastructure as Code, observability and safe continuous delivery the default rather than the exception. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. Along the way, you will collaborate with engineers, influence technical direction and leave the platform in a significantly better state than you found it. Your role You will become one of the technical driving forces behind the cloud platforms that power our digital health applications. Working closely with fellow engineers, product teams and colleagues across countries, you will help shape and improve our cloud infrastructure, strengthen the developer experience and ensure reliability, security and scalability are built into the foundations of our technology. Your exact focus will evolve with the needs of our teams and the opportunities you identify to make a lasting impact. This is a role for someone who enjoys solving difficult engineering problems without chasing complexity for complexity's sake. You will help us balance innovation with pragmatism, modernising a live healthcare platform while maintaining the stability that patients and healthcare professionals depend on every day. What you will be doing, among others: Design, build and evolve our AWS platform using Terraform as the single source of truth, while driving the gradual modernisation of our cloud landscape; Build reusable infrastructure, deployment pipelines and platform tooling that enable engineering teams to ship independently and safely; Introduce pragmatic cloud-native and event-driven solutions where they genuinely improve scalability, reliability and maintainability; Make observability a default through standardised monitoring, logging, dashboards and alerting across the platform; Improve deployment practices with automated CI/CD, progressive delivery and reliable rollback strategies; Embed security, compliance and cost optimisation into the platform through automated guardrails and best practices; Coach fellow engineers, review infrastructure and application code, and raise the overall cloud engineering bar through collaboration and example. The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together. Why Luscii? Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH ; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better. Most important benefits Salary : Naturally, this depends on your background, experience, and relevant expertise. You may think of a maximum salary of approximately €86.000,- to €94.000,- per year for this position. Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii . Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. The ideal candidate… … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. You have at least 6 years of experience building and operating large-scale cloud platforms, with deep hands-on AWS expertise and including the same amount of experience in senior-level ownership of modern cloud architectures; You have extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and treat infrastructure with the same rigour as application code; You have a strong understanding of cloud-native, serverless and event-driven architectures, and the judgement to apply them pragmatically; You know how to build reliable production systems with observability, automated deployments and safe release practices built in; You enjoy modernising legacy platforms through incremental improvements rather than big-bang rewrites, while bringing others along in the process; You have strong backend engineering experience, preferably with Node.js and TypeScript; You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities; English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language. Interested? Apply now! Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via What does the recruitment process look like? We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Founding LPA Engineer (m/f/d)
raw.description:
Applicants from the EU and non-EU are welcome to apply

▪ Industry: Deep-tech / Active Muon Imaging & Laser-Plasma Accelerators

▪ HQ & Locations: Hamburg (DE) – HQ; Tallinn (EE)

▪ Size: 1–10 employees

Company Mission

The company develops safe, rapid and accurate active muon imaging solutions for industrial quality assessment, security and customs inspection and medical diagnostics. Their platform combines laser-plasma-accelerator-driven muon sources, next-generation particle detectors and AI to enable high-resolution 3D imaging with automated decision-making. The company operates at DESY in Hamburg, Germany, and Tehnopol in Tallinn, Estonia. Their main development partners span the energy, defence, aerospace and security industries. Their initial technology and business focus is on the quality and safety assessment of critical metallic and ceramic components, such as rocket engines, gas turbines, jet engines, and large-scale nuclear or industrial systems.

Core Values

Skunkworks approach: They work in small teams with full ownership. They keep it simple, stupid. Move fast: a shiny prototype means they spent too long on it. They build to learn. They polish later. Disagree together, commit together: they debate and challenge, regardless of title. Then they deliver the decision as one team. They win as a team. They pivot as a team.

Courage: they always make the call. A mistake isn't a failure: it's proof they're improving. Either way, the own the outcome. Honesty and transparency: they share what's really happening, good or bad. That lets everyone make the right call. They stay open. They stay honest.

Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Assemble and lead the Muon Source team, covering LPA, converter, and optics; start hands-on, hire and structure the team as the work grows

  • Oversee the development of working points and a density-tailored plasma source that survives the thermal load of a 100 Hz, 100 TW focus—millions of consistent shots, not one good shot

  • Lead the development of the plasma source and execute experiments at user facilities to iterate the design toward powering the transportable muon source

  • Isolate the laser specs that matter most—pulse energy, duration, pointing and energy stability, beam quality—and ensure they get delivered

  • Own the vacuum system and the laser transport line, including vacuum chambers, differential pumping, vibration management and thermal management, turning the LPA into a machine that fits inside a shipping container and runs 24/7

  • Define the requirements for the control system, the machine protection system, and the diagnostics suite that let the machine run unattended

  • Manage the budget and make technical decisions within your area of responsibility

  • Participate in hiring processes to expand the Muon Source team as the scope grows

Requirements

  • Team leadership. You've built and led a technical team before. You're ready to be hands-on again before this one exists

  • Hands-on LPA experience. You've built and operated a laser-plasma accelerator. Not just modeled one. Injection, dephasing, depletion, and guiding physics you've tuned on real hardware

  • Experimental leadership at user facilities. You've planned and run a multi-year experimental campaign before. You know how to iterate a design from real beamtime data

  • High-power laser system literacy. You can write a spec a laser manufacturer can build to: pulse energy, duration, pointing and energy stability, beam quality. You hold vendors to it

  • Vacuum and opto-mechanical engineering judgment. You know what vacuum chamber design, differential pumping, vibration isolation, and thermal management require to keep the LPA running under continuous, high-average-power use

  • Controls and diagnostics systems thinking. You can translate "runs unattended, 24/7" into concrete requirements for a control system, a machine protection system, and a diagnostics suite, even where another team builds them

  • Minimum 3 to 5 years postdoc experience

  • Doctorate (PhD / Dr.) required

  • At least full professional proficiency in English; German or Estonian is a plus

  • Willingness to work primarily on-site in Hamburg (no full remote; approximately one home-office day per week)

  • Occasional travel required to visit and work at different research facilities across the world

  • Ability to start in January 2027 or latest February 2027

Core Benefits

  • Key Role with Direct Impact: Without your LPA, our core product – the transportable muon source – cannot operate

  • Founding Role with High Autonomy: Build both the accelerator team and the machine from the ground up, taking full ownership of technical and budget decisions

  • Unique Deep-Tech Challenge: Hands-on work with laser-plasma accelerators at 100 Hz / 100 TW and active muon imaging technology that is revolutionizing industrial inspection

  • Access to World-Class Infrastructure: On-demand beamtime at multi-GeV facilities such as DESY PRIMA, plus collaborations with ELI Beamlines, EPAC, and ATLAS

  • Strong Network & Visibility: Collaborate with leading partners such as DESY, DLR, Siemens Energy, Marvel Fusion, and other high-tech organizations

  • Attractive Compensation Package plus a substantial employee equity program and relocation support, including for non-EU candidates

  • Culture of Ownership & Speed: A skunkworks approach, flat hierarchies, bold decision-making, and full transparency create an environment for personal growth

Sie wollen Verantwortung übernehmen – und nicht nur Prozesse verwalten?

Dann sollten Sie unseren Kunden kennenlernen, ein international aufgestelltes Hightech-Unternehmen. Im Engineering Management suchen wir für den Kunden eine Persönlichkeit, die Produktion und Technologieentwicklung gleichermaßen vorantreibt. Der Kunde entwickelt und fertigt Präzisionsprodukte, die weltweit Maßstäbe setzen. Wir freuen uns über Ihre Bewerbung. Viele Grüße, Alexander Wuthenow (Inhaber wabcon)

Aufgabengebiet

Sie führen ein Team aus Ingenieurinnen, Technikerinnen und Führungskräften – fachlich wie disziplinarisch – und entwickeln es aktiv weiter. Sie tragen die Verantwortung dafür, dass Leistungs-, Qualitäts-, Kosten- und Verfügbarkeitsziele erreicht werden. Und: Sie machen daraus nicht nur Zahlen, sondern laufend bessere Prozesse, Anlagen und Abläufe.

Dazu gehören auch eigene Projekte. Sie initiieren Technologie- und Optimierungsvorhaben, planen sie und bringen sie über die Ziellinie. Für Ihren Bereich entwickeln Sie Strategien und Roadmaps – und setzen sie gemeinsam mit internen Partnern, unseren Kunden und Standorten im Ausland um. Kurze Wege inklusive.

Anforderungsprofil

Sie haben ein abgeschlossenes naturwissenschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Sie haben bereits Berufserfahrung in einem technologisch anspruchsvollen industriellen Umfeld gesammelt, idealerweise in der Hightech-Fertigung, und dabei schon Teams geführt und komplexe Projekte zum Erfolg gebracht.

Prozess-, Technologie- oder Anlagenmanagement kennen Sie nicht nur vom Hörensagen. Sie denken analytisch, arbeiten strukturiert und verlieren auch in hektischen Phasen nicht den Blick für die Lösung. Und weil bei unserem Kunde viel in Eigenverantwortung entschieden wird, bringen Sie unternehmerisches Denken mit – zusammen mit sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen.

Benefits

Arbeiten Sie dort, wo Entwicklung und Fertigung modernster Hightech-Produkte unter einem Dach stattfinden. Sie bekommen vielseitige Aufgaben in einem internationalen Team, eine marktorientierte, attraktive Vergütung – und die Chance, am Erfolg des Unternehmens auch finanziell zu partizipieren.

Klingt gut? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Kontakt

Haben Sie Fragen?Ansprechpartner: Alexander Wuthenow, Tel: 030 2065 84-59

title: Trade Marketing Manager:in
description: Jobbeschreibung Hey! Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun sondern auch unserem Planeten. Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Aber das soll erst der Anfang sein! Neben der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produkte ist natürlich unsere Sichtbarkeit im Handel mit der wichtigsten Treiber für die Zukunft von vly. Hier beginnt dein nächster Schritt bei vly... Deine Mission: Als Trade Marketing Manager:in bist du die Brücke zwischen unserer Marke und dem Handel . Du sorgst dafür, dass vly maximale Aufmerksamkeit im Regal bekommt – durch überzeugende Argumente, aufmerksamkeitsstarke Materialien und aktivierende Maßnahmen, die unsere Produkte noch schneller aus dem Regal heraus verkaufen. Du berichtest an unsere Head of Marketing, arbeitest aber auch sehr eng mit Sales, Brand und Design zusammen und bist dabei eine der Schlüsselpersonen, die das große Bild von der Brand bis zur Regalplatzierung versteht. Deine Rolle: Du trägst zur Entwicklung unserer Trademarketing-Strategie für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz bei und bist für deren Umsetzung verantwortlich. Du unterstützt unser KAM- und Field-Force-Team beim Entwickeln von überzeugenden Sell-in-Unterlagen und Category-Management-Argumenten für einschlägige LEH-Kunden. Du planst und koordinierst POS-Maßnahmen: Displayaktionen, Zweitplatzierungen und In-Store-Aktivierungen (z.B. Gewinnspiele). Du analysierst Marktdaten (Nielsen, GfK, interne Sell-out-Daten) und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Du entwickelst starke Trade Marketing Materialien (z.B. Sales Folder, Präsentationen, Wobbler) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Brand, Design und Sales. Du organisierst und standardisierst unseren Auftritt bei Trade Messen und Verkostungen in Supermärkten. Du beobachtest den Wettbewerb sowie die Regalentwicklung und bringst proaktiv Impulse, die unsere Sichtbarkeit und den Impact am POS erhöhen. Du bist das Verbindungsstück zwischen Marketing, KAM und Field Force mit dem Ziel, effektive Maßnahmen auf Kundenbedürfnisse zuzuschneiden. Deine Benefits: Purpose: Es ist absolut essenziell, dass sich das Lebensmittelsystem zum Besseren verändert. Deine Rolle trägt direkt dazu bei, es gesünder und nachhaltiger zu machen. Impact vom ersten Tag: Du baust Trade Marketing bei vly auf – keine fertige Struktur, die du übernimmst, sondern echte Ownership. Echtes Startup Teamgefühl: Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events. Teamlunch : Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserer eigenen vly-Köchin! Mobilität und Company Fitness: Zuschuss sowohl zum BVG / Deutschland-Ticket sowie zu deiner USC Mitgliedschaft. Moderne Ausstattung & Coaching: Wir statten dich mit Mac/Windows-Equipment aus und bieten individuelle Coaching-Möglichkeiten. FoodTech-Community: Sei Teil einer wachsenden Bewegung, mit spannenden Events und Networking-Möglichkeiten. vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst! Stellenanforderungen Dein Profil: Hands-on Erfahrung: Du hast 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Trade Marketing oder Category Management in einer FMCG-Brand oder im LEH-Umfeld. Expertise: Du hast bereits Trade Marketing Konzepte eigenverantwortlich entwickelt und umgesetzt. Displayaktionen, Sonderplatzierungen und kreative Materialien sind für dich kein Neuland. Netzwerk: Du hast ein Netzwerk von einschlägigen Herstellern von Trade Materialien und kennst die Produktionsprozesse vom Design-Briefing bis zum Versand. Daten sind deine Grundlage: Du kannst Nielsen-Daten und interne Daten lesen, interpretieren und in überzeugende Storys für den Handel übersetzen. raw.description:
Jobbeschreibung

Hey!

Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun sondern auch unserem Planeten. Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Aber das soll erst der Anfang sein! Neben der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produkte ist natürlich unsere Sichtbarkeit im Handel mit der wichtigsten Treiber für die Zukunft von vly. Hier beginnt dein nächster Schritt bei vly...

Deine Mission: Als Trade Marketing Manager:in bist du die Brücke zwischen unserer Marke und dem Handel. Du sorgst dafür, dass vly maximale Aufmerksamkeit im Regal bekommt – durch überzeugende Argumente, aufmerksamkeitsstarke Materialien und aktivierende Maßnahmen, die unsere Produkte noch schneller aus dem Regal heraus verkaufen. Du berichtest an unsere Head of Marketing, arbeitest aber auch sehr eng mit Sales, Brand und Design zusammen und bist dabei eine der Schlüsselpersonen, die das große Bild von der Brand bis zur Regalplatzierung versteht.

Deine Rolle:

  • Du trägst zur Entwicklung unserer Trademarketing-Strategie für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz bei und bist für deren Umsetzung verantwortlich.
  • Du unterstützt unser KAM- und Field-Force-Team beim Entwickeln von überzeugenden Sell-in-Unterlagen und Category-Management-Argumenten für einschlägige LEH-Kunden.
  • Du planst und koordinierst POS-Maßnahmen: Displayaktionen, Zweitplatzierungen und In-Store-Aktivierungen (z.B. Gewinnspiele).
  • Du analysierst Marktdaten (Nielsen, GfK, interne Sell-out-Daten) und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.
  • Du entwickelst starke Trade Marketing Materialien (z.B. Sales Folder, Präsentationen, Wobbler) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Brand, Design und Sales.
  • Du organisierst und standardisierst unseren Auftritt bei Trade Messen und Verkostungen in Supermärkten.
  • Du beobachtest den Wettbewerb sowie die Regalentwicklung und bringst proaktiv Impulse, die unsere Sichtbarkeit und den Impact am POS erhöhen.
  • Du bist das Verbindungsstück zwischen Marketing, KAM und Field Force mit dem Ziel, effektive Maßnahmen auf Kundenbedürfnisse zuzuschneiden.

Deine Benefits:

  • Purpose: Es ist absolut essenziell, dass sich das Lebensmittelsystem zum Besseren verändert. Deine Rolle trägt direkt dazu bei, es gesünder und nachhaltiger zu machen.
  • Impact vom ersten Tag: Du baust Trade Marketing bei vly auf – keine fertige Struktur, die du übernimmst, sondern echte Ownership.
  • Echtes Startup Teamgefühl: Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events.
  • Teamlunch: Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserer eigenen vly-Köchin!
  • Mobilität und Company Fitness: Zuschuss sowohl zum BVG / Deutschland-Ticket sowie zu deiner USC Mitgliedschaft.
  • Moderne Ausstattung & Coaching: Wir statten dich mit Mac/Windows-Equipment aus und bieten individuelle Coaching-Möglichkeiten.
  • FoodTech-Community: Sei Teil einer wachsenden Bewegung, mit spannenden Events und Networking-Möglichkeiten.
  • vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst!

Stellenanforderungen

Dein Profil:

  • Hands-on Erfahrung: Du hast 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Trade Marketing oder Category Management in einer FMCG-Brand oder im LEH-Umfeld.
  • Expertise: Du hast bereits Trade Marketing Konzepte eigenverantwortlich entwickelt und umgesetzt. Displayaktionen, Sonderplatzierungen und kreative Materialien sind für dich kein Neuland.
  • Netzwerk: Du hast ein Netzwerk von einschlägigen Herstellern von Trade Materialien und kennst die Produktionsprozesse vom Design-Briefing bis zum Versand.

title: Senior UX & Interaction Designer (m/w/d) | Industrial Software | Teilzeit
description: HappyOps entwickelt moderne Softwarelösungen für die produzierende Industrie. Unsere Anwendungen unterstützen Maschinenbediener, Schichtleiter, Instandhalter und Produktionsmanager bei ihrer täglichen Arbeit, von der Produktionsüberwachung über Qualitätsmanagement bis hin zu digitalen Arbeitsabläufen und KI gestützten Assistenzsystemen. Wir verfügen über ein erfahrenes Engineering Team, das unsere Kunden von der Anforderungsanalyse über die technische Konzeption bis zur produktiven Umsetzung begleitet. Gleichzeitig entwickeln wir uns zunehmend vom individuellen Lösungsgeschäft hin zu einer skalierbaren Softwareplattform. Was uns dabei noch fehlt, ist eine konsequente Spezialisierung auf User Experience, Interaktionskonzepte und intuitive Nutzerführung. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Wir suchen eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die komplexe Prozesse versteht, sich in unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen hineinversetzen kann und daraus einfache, effiziente und konsistente Bedienkonzepte entwickelt. Dabei geht es ausdrücklich nicht primär um visuelles UI Design. Unser Team kann moderne Oberflächen mit bestehenden Designsystemen und KI gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen bereits sehr gut umsetzen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Frage, wie unsere Software funktioniert und wie Menschen mit ihr interagieren. Welche Informationen benötigt ein Nutzer in welcher Situation? Wie navigiert er durch komplexe Anwendungen? Welche Aktionen müssen unmittelbar verfügbar sein? Wie lassen sich mehrstufige Arbeitsabläufe vereinfachen? Wie vermeiden wir unnötige Klicks, Medienbrüche und kognitive Belastung? Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Gründerteam und unseren Software Engineers zusammen und prägst die User Experience unserer wachsenden Softwareplattform. Wir suchen ausdrücklich eine erfahrene Person, die eigenständig UX Konzepte entwickeln und fundierte Produktentscheidungen treffen kann. Die Position ist auf eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit in Teilzeit mit etwa 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche ausgelegt. Über das konkrete Arbeitsmodell sprechen wir gerne individuell. Aufgaben Interaction & Workflow Design: Du entwickelst intuitive Interaktionskonzepte für komplexe industrielle Softwareanwendungen und optimierst die Abläufe zwischen Informationen, Entscheidungen und Aktionen. User Journey & Task Flow Design: Du analysierst, wie unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen ihre täglichen Aufgaben erledigen, und entwickelst daraus effiziente, verständliche und möglichst reibungslose Bedienabläufe. Information Architecture & Navigation: Du konzipierst die Informationsstruktur und Navigation unserer Anwendungen. Nutzer sollen relevante Informationen und Funktionen schnell, intuitiv und ohne unnötige Schritte erreichen. User Research & Prozessanalyse: Du verstehst die Arbeitsrealität von Maschinenbedienern, Schichtleitern, Instandhaltern und Produktionsmanagern und übersetzt deren Anforderungen in konkrete UX Konzepte. Komplexität reduzieren: Du hinterfragst bestehende Workflows, identifizierst unnötige Interaktionen und entwickelst Lösungen, die auch unter Zeitdruck und in anspruchsvollen Produktionsumgebungen funktionieren. Produktübergreifende UX: Du entwickelst konsistente Navigations- und Interaktionsmuster für unsere wachsende Softwareplattform und sorgst für ein einheitliches Nutzererlebnis über verschiedene Anwendungen hinweg. Konzeption & Validierung: Du visualisierst Konzepte durch User Flows, einfache Wireframes oder interaktive Prototypen und validierst sie gemeinsam mit Entwicklern und tatsächlichen Anwendern. Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem erfahrenen Entwicklerteam zusammen, diskutierst technische Möglichkeiten und stellst sicher, dass Nutzerfreundlichkeit von Anfang an in die Produktentwicklung einfließt. Qualifikation Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich User Experience, Interaction Design, UX Architecture oder Product Design, idealerweise mindestens fünf Jahre. Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Konzeption komplexer B2B Software, Enterprise Applications oder datenintensiver Anwendungen. Ausgeprägte Kompetenz in Information Architecture, Navigation Design, User Journeys, Task Flows und Workflow Optimierung. Fähigkeit, komplexe fachliche Prozesse zu analysieren, zu strukturieren und in einfache, intuitive Interaktionskonzepte zu übersetzen. Erfahrung mit nutzerzentrierten Methoden wie User Research, Usability Testing, Journey Mapping und Prototyping. Verständnis für unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen, ihre Aufgaben, Entscheidungsprozesse und Arbeitsumgebungen. Fähigkeit, UX Entscheidungen fundiert zu begründen und eigenständig mit Produktverantwortlichen und Softwareentwicklern zu diskutieren. Pragmatische, analytische und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit einem klaren Fokus auf funktionierende Lösungen statt aufwendiger Designprozesse. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Erfahrung mit industrieller Software, MES, ERP oder vergleichbaren komplexen Fachanwendungen ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wichtig: Wir suchen keinen klassischen UI Designer, dessen Schwerpunkt auf visueller Gestaltung, Branding oder der Erstellung schöner Screens liegt. Entscheidend ist deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Software durch bessere Interaktionen, Navigation und Workflows einfacher nutzbar zu machen. Benefits Direkter Einfluss auf das Produkt: Du definierst, wie Nutzer mit unserer Software arbeiten, und prägst grundlegende Interaktions- und Navigationskonzepte. Erfahrenes Engineering Team: Du konzentrierst dich auf UX Konzeption und Nutzerführung, während unser Entwicklerteam die technische Umsetzung übernimmt. Schnelle Umsetzung: Deine Konzepte können mit modernen Entwicklungswerkzeugen und KI Unterstützung schnell prototypisiert, getestet und produktiv umgesetzt werden. Direkter Zugang zu Anwendern: Du erhältst Einblicke in reale Produktionsumgebungen und kannst deine Ideen mit den Menschen validieren, die unsere Software täglich nutzen. Hohe Eigenverantwortung: Du entwickelst eigenständig Konzepte und arbeitest direkt mit unserem Gründerteam zusammen. Flexible Teilzeit: Etwa 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche mit flexibler Arbeitszeitgestaltung und der Möglichkeit zu hybridem Arbeiten. Langfristige Perspektive: Du gestaltest die User Experience einer wachsenden industriellen Softwareplattform mit. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Dans le cadre de projets de transformation digitale au sein d’un groupe international du secteur des sciences de la vie, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) MES – Qualification & Déploiement pour accompagner l’évolution et le déploiement de solutions informatiques industrielles sur plusieurs sites en Europe.

Vous interviendrez sur la qualification d’une solution MES (Manufacturing Execution System), destinée à soutenir et à optimiser les processus de production, tout en garantissant sa conformité aux exigences qualité et réglementaires du secteur.

Ce poste combine des activités de qualification logicielle, de validation des systèmes informatisés et d’accompagnement au déploiement. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes locales et internationales afin d’assurer une mise en œuvre cohérente de la solution, dans le respect des standards et des bonnes pratiques en vigueur.

Votre rôle et missions

Votre rôle

En tant qu’Ingénieur(e) MES – Qualification & Déploiement, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la qualification du système et l’accompagnement de son déploiement sur différents sites européens.

Vous veillerez à la fiabilité, à la conformité et à la bonne intégration de la solution dans les environnements industriels concernés.

À l’interface entre les équipes IT, les équipes de production, les interlocuteurs qualité et les équipes projet, vous contribuerez à sécuriser les différentes étapes du cycle de vie de la solution, de la préparation des activités de qualification jusqu’à sa mise en service opérationnelle.

🎯 Missions

🔹 Qualification & validation du système MES

* Participer à la définition et à l’exécution de la stratégie de qualification et de validation du logiciel MES.

* Rédiger, revoir et exécuter les protocoles de tests et la documentation de validation.

* Préparer et réaliser les tests fonctionnels, les tests d’intégration et les tests de non-régression.

* Identifier, documenter et suivre les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution.

* Assurer la traçabilité des exigences, des tests et des résultats de qualification.

* Veiller au respect des procédures qualité et des exigences réglementaires applicables aux systèmes informatisés.

🔹 Déploiement international

* Participer au déploiement de la solution MES sur plusieurs sites en Europe.

* Accompagner les équipes locales dans la préparation, l’exécution et la validation des activités de déploiement.

* Contribuer à l’adaptation de la solution aux spécificités opérationnelles des différents sites, dans le respect des standards définis.

* Coordonner les activités avec les équipes projet internationales et les parties prenantes locales.

* Participer à la préparation des mises en production et au suivi des premières phases d’exploitation.

🔹 Documentation & conformité

* Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique et qualité liée aux activités de qualification.

* Veiller à la conformité des livrables avec les procédures internes et les exigences applicables au secteur.

* Participer à la préparation des revues qualité et des audits, lorsque nécessaire.

* Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de qualification et de déploiement.

🔹 Collaboration & support

* Collaborer avec les équipes IT, qualité, production et métiers afin de garantir une compréhension commune des besoins.

* Faciliter la communication entre les équipes centrales et les équipes locales des différents sites.

* Apporter un support méthodologique et fonctionnel durant les phases de tests et de déploiement.

* Participer au transfert de connaissances et à l’accompagnement des utilisateurs concernés.

  • * Connaissance des méthodologies de validation et des bonnes pratiques documentaires.

  • * Expérience dans la rédaction et l’exécution de protocoles de tests, ainsi que dans la gestion des anomalies.

title: Manager, Engineering - Product
description: At ClickUp , we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a product engineering team at ClickUp. This is an open team placement role: you'll join a product team based on your strengths and our business priorities, rather than being hired into a single predefined product area. Across teams, the mandate is the same: build a strong team, ship useful product improvements, and take ownership of the quality and reliability of what you deliver. Engineering Managers at ClickUp are hands-on. You'll lead from the front: reading and reviewing code daily, debugging production issues alongside your team, prototyping when it unblocks a decision, and shipping code yourself when the team needs it. Your technical credibility is how you earn trust, set the bar, and make good calls quickly. You'll also own people management, delivery, and team execution. Working closely with product, design, and technical leads, you'll turn customer problems into clear priorities and achievable milestones. You'll develop engineers, make trade-offs explicit, and keep work moving without letting quality or maintainability become someone else's problem. You'll also run an AI-native team . We structure work so AI agents can read it, route it, roll it up, and report on it. Progress and team health should be visible from real signals, with reporting available self-serve rather than dependent on status meetings. We want a manager who has used AI to remove busywork and improve how a team builds, and who can help engineers use it responsibly across planning, implementation, testing, and operations. Responsibilities Lead and develop a product engineering team. Own hiring, onboarding, mentorship, performance, and career growth, and build a team where expectations are clear and feedback is direct. Own delivery from planning through release and follow-through. Break work into clear milestones, manage dependencies, surface risks early, and make realistic commitments. Set priorities with product, design, and engineering leadership. Connect engineering work to customer needs and business outcomes, and make deliberate trade-offs between new features, reliability, and technical debt. Lead from the front technically. Stay close to the codebase: review PRs, dig into production issues, write code and prototypes when it unblocks the team, and know your systems well enough to spot risk before it ships. Drive architecture and implementation decisions with your technical leads and senior engineers. Bring real depth to design discussions, challenge assumptions with specifics, and make the call when the team is stuck. Run an AI-native team. Use AI tools and agentic workflows to improve planning, development, testing, triage, and reporting, while maintaining clear ownership and human review where it matters. Uphold a high engineering bar across design and code review, automated testing, performance, security, and maintainability. Build quality into delivery rather than treating it as a final checkpoint. Own the operational health of your team's product area. Establish appropriate monitoring, safe rollout practices, incident response, and on-call ownership, and turn production issues into lasting improvements. Collaborate across product teams and shared platform teams to resolve dependencies and deliver coherent customer experiences. Keep priorities, progress, risks, and decisions visible. Use evidence to improve team execution and product outcomes, rather than optimizing for activity counts. Requirements 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building production software, including substantial time as a hands-on senior engineer, with 2+ years managing an engineering team. You still code. You're comfortable working in a modern production codebase (TypeScript, Node.js, React, or similar), reviewing PRs with substance, and debugging across the stack. A track record of delivering customer-facing SaaS products or services, with ownership extending beyond launch to reliability, maintenance, and customer outcomes. Experience hiring, coaching, and developing engineers, including giving direct feedback, managing performance, and supporting career growth. Deep technical judgment. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs from first-hand experience, and hold a high engineering bar because you know what good looks like in the code. Experience partnering closely with product and design to define priorities, scope work, and deliver against clear milestones. A demonstrated ability to use AI tools and agentic workflows to improve engineering work and reduce manual coordination, with attention to correctness, security, and review. Comfort working through ambiguity, learning unfamiliar product areas, and making decisions with incomplete information. Clear communication and effective cross-functional collaboration. You make ownership, trade-offs, risks, and next steps easy to understand. Daily fluency with AI tools in your own workflow. Preferred Qualifications Recent, meaningful code contributions as a manager: features, fixes, tooling, or prototypes you shipped yourself. Experience managing engineers across frontend and backend, or leading delivery across multiple technical disciplines. Experience building and operating software at scale, including performance, reliability, safe migrations, and incident management. Experience in a fast-moving product organization, balancing customer-facing delivery with platform improvements and technical debt. Experience introducing AI-native or agent-driven workflows to an engineering team, with measurable improvements in quality or execution. Experience building collaboration, productivity, or workflow software, or products used by both individual users and enterprise customers. Experience leading distributed teams across time zones. Equal Opportunity Employer ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. Privacy Notice ClickUp collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. You can find further details by viewing our Global Candidate Privacy Notice. If you are a Philippine Job Applicant, please also see our Philippine Data Privacy Notice for further details. Visa Sponsorship Please note we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for roles outside of engineering and product at this time. Sponsorship for engineering and product roles is not guaranteed, but is instead based on the business needs for that specific role at that time. Please reach out to the recruiter with any questions. Fraud Alert ClickUp Talent Acquisition will only initiate contact via an @ clickup.com email or through our official careers portal on clickup.com . We will never request fees, payments, or sensitive personal information. Please disregard any offers received outside these channels and report them to support@clickup.com. AI Processing Notice ClickUp may use artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to help review and screen candidates' employment applications against role-related criteria. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision‑making. If you have questions or need an accommodation in the recruitment process, please contact us at AskPeople@ClickUp.com.

title: Principal Engineer, Duo Agent Platform
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. About the role We are looking for a Principal Engineer to help build GitLab Duo Agent Platform, the agentic orchestration layer that runs AI agents and flows across the entire software lifecycle. Principal Engineers at GitLab are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the senior technical leadership within their organization. In this role you will set technical direction for a significant part of the Agent Platform, working across several teams to turn agentic capabilities into something engineering organizations can actually depend on: predictable, observable, governable, and fast enough to sit in the critical path of real development work. The Agent Platform is not a single service. It spans agent execution and orchestration, flow definition and event-driven triggering, the AI Catalog through which customers discover and manage agents, model routing and evaluation, and the governance surface that decides which agents may act where and under whose identity. It runs on GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed installations, including deployments that use self-hosted models to meet compliance requirements. You will work on the parts of that system where the hard architectural questions live, and you will do it hands-on. This role reports into the VP of the AI Engineering organization and works closely with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Product Management, Infrastructure and Security. What you'll do Define the technical direction for a significant area of Duo Agent Platform across several teams, and partner with Engineering Managers and Product to turn it into a roadmap with a six-month horizon. Build the orchestration layer that makes agents and flows reliable: session lifecycle, tool invocation, context assembly, concurrency, retries, timeouts, and failure modes that degrade gracefully instead of stalling a developer's workflow. Hands on work on driving topics throughout the whole organisation from POC level, architecture to full implementation. Participate in Incident Management on-call rotation, to help meet availability goals for GitLab.com. Strong product builder and ownership mentality. Understanding of product strategy, technical strategy, delivering customer value and iteration towards a successful product Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let other teams make aligned decisions. raw.jobDescription:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

About the role

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to help build GitLab Duo Agent Platform, the agentic orchestration layer that runs AI agents and flows across the entire software lifecycle.

Principal Engineers at GitLab are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the senior technical leadership within their organization. In this role you will set technical direction for a significant part of the Agent Platform, working across several teams to turn agentic capabilities into something engineering organizations can actually depend on: predictable, observable, governable, and fast enough to sit in the critical path of real development work.

The Agent Platform is not a single service. It spans agent execution and orchestration, flow definition and event-driven triggering, the AI Catalog through which customers discover and manage agents, model routing and evaluation, and the governance surface that decides which agents may act where and under whose identity. It runs on GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed installations, including deployments that use self-hosted models to meet compliance requirements. You will work on the parts of that system where the hard architectural questions live, and you will do it hands-on.

This role reports into the VP of the AI Engineering organization and works closely with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Product Management, Infrastructure and Security.

What you'll do

  • Define the technical direction for a significant area of Duo Agent Platform across several teams, and partner with Engineering Managers and Product to turn it into a roadmap with a six-month horizon.
  • Build the orchestration layer that makes agents and flows reliable: session lifecycle, tool invocation, context assembly, concurrency, retries, timeouts, and failure modes that degrade gracefully instead of stalling a developer's workflow.
  • Hands on work on driving topics throughout the whole organisation from POC level, architecture to full implementation.
  • Participate in Incident Management on-call rotation, to help meet availability goals for GitLab.com.
  • Strong product builder and ownership mentality. Understanding of product strategy, technical strategy, delivering customer value and iteration towards a successful product
  • Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let other teams make aligned decisions. Ensure the architecture holds across multi-tenant GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments, including self-hosted model configurations, and respects data governance boundaries in each.
  • Use the platform on our own work, find where it falls short of what we claim, and feed that back through improvements into the product.
  • Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers, and raise the bar for experimentation rigor and cross-team collaboration.
  • Work across the whole platform on different projects, features and teams. This reaches across:
    • Design the extensibility surface so customers can build custom agents and flows, connect their own tools and internal systems, and bring external agents such as Claude Code and Codex into GitLab workflows without weakening the platform's guarantees.
    • Drive down the cost and latency of agentic requests, and work with Product on how model selection, routing, and credit consumption behave as usage grows.
    • Define the evaluation practice for the platform: offline benchmarks and online experiments that measure task completion, correctness, tool-call accuracy, latency, and cost per task, and that catch regressions before customers do.
    • Build the governance and safety surface with Security and Compliance: policy-driven controls over which agents and models may run where, permission and identity semantics that align to existing roles and group structure, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, traceability of every flow session, and audit that stands up to enterprise review.
  • Complete Interview Training and participate in hiring for the department as a technical interviewer or panel member.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years at Staff, Principal level or equivalent senior technical leadership.
  • Hands-on production experience building on large language models: agent loops, tool calling, context management, retrieval, prompt and model evaluation. Experience shipping this to real users, not only prototyping it.
  • Strong background in distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience under multi-tenant load.
  • A track record of defining evaluation frameworks and using benchmark and experiment results to make architecture decisions, rather than shipping on intuition.
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop controls, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for systems that act on a customer's behalf.
  • Ability to drive alignment across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Security on problems that start out ambiguous.
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority.
  • Comfort working in one or more of Ruby, Go, Python, or TypeScript, and willingness to work across the stack the platform spans.
  • Excellent written and asynchronous communication, and the ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization.

About the team

The AI engineering organisation is building the product and infrastructure that make GitLab an effective environment for running agents across the software development lifecycle. We’re distributed across the world and partner with teams throughout GitLab to help the GitLab Duo Agent Platform become the backbone of GitLab's AI features. You will report directly to the VP of Engineering for AI and especially work together with all the teams, the engineering management and other principal engineers in the AI department. This is an opportunity to lead a consequential group as AI changes how software is built.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

raw.jobDescription:
Role Description

As a Full Stack Engineer at Dropbox, you will help design and develop the seamless, scalable, and user-friendly experiences Dropbox users depend on. Your work will encompass both front-end and back-end development, supporting products that empower millions worldwide. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to transform ideas into reliable, scalable features that provide outstanding user experiences. This year, Dropbox is on a mission to expedite the creation and implementation of AI-enabled products, providing a comprehensive technology stack for rapid prototyping and reliable deployment of AI-augmented functionality.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build scalable software solutions across specific product areas or multi-component systems
  • Write and review code, demonstrating technical leadership while mentoring junior engineers
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify user needs and create impactful solutions
  • Develop and execute comprehensive roadmaps balancing technical quality, business impact, and user experience
  • Contribute to the team culture through mentorship, interviewing, and active engagement in new initiatives

On-call work may be necessary occasionally to help address bugs, outages, or other operational issues, with the goal of maintaining a stable and high-quality experience for our customers.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or related roles
  • Experience in both front-end (JavaScript, React, Angular, HTML/CSS) and back-end (Node.js, Python) development
  • BS degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent experience
  • Success developing and deploying large-scale full-stack applications
  • Proficiency in building front-end interfaces and back-end systems, delivering minimum viable products quickly
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations as needed by the team

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Bei uns gibt es keinen endlosen Bewerbungsprozess. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Anschreiben, damit wir ein bisschen mehr über dich erfahren.   • Gestaltung und Nutzung digitaler Workflows (z. B. Belegflüsse, Freigabeprozesse, Dokumentenmanagement)
  • Bei entsprechender Erfahrung: eigenverantwortliche Projektsteuerung end-to-end sowie, wenn vorhanden, das Einbringen deines eigenen Mandanten-Netzwerks zum Ausbau unseres Kundenportfolios

Was du mitbringen solltest

Wir wissen: Nicht jede/jeder erfüllt alles und das ist völlig in Ordnung. Bewirb dich, wenn ein Großteil auf dich zutrifft:

  • Idealerweise (für erfahrene Profile) Praxis aus einer Steuerkanzlei/einem Steuerbüro sowie Beteiligung an oder eigenständige Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Kenntnisse in HGB und Finanzbuchhaltung, je nach Level Grundkenntnisse oder umfassende Expertise
  • Begeisterung für digitale Innovationen und Erfahrung bzw. Offenheit im Umgang mit digitalen Workflows
  • Kenntnisse in Microsoft M365 und DATEV (Grundkenntnisse wünschenswert bis sicherer Umgang); Erfahrung mit Business Central, Oracle oder branchenspezifischen ERP-Systemen von Vorteil
  • Ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis, Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit
  • Eine selbstständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit, digital wie persönlich
  • Von Vorteil (kein Muss): ein eigenes Mandanten-Netzwerk, das du mit einbringen möchtest

Was wir dir bieten

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Bring deine Ideen ein und gestalte aktiv die Zukunft der Buchhaltung mit
  • Verantwortung & Entwicklung: Baue unser Team in Düsseldorf mit auf, mit echtem Raum für deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung: Bleib am Puls der digitalen Entwicklung, insbesondere bei Workflows und Automatisierung
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Remote oder im modernen Büro mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen in der Düsseldorfer Altstadt, du hast die Wahl
  • Work-Life-Balance: 30 Urlaubstage, zusätzlich frei an Heiligabend und Silvester sowie flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Mitarbeiter-Benefits: spendit-Karte, kostenlose Getränke, regelmäßige Teamevents (in Planung)
  • Mobilität: Fahrtkostenzuschuss für das Deutschlandticket und JobRad-Leasing

Über uns

Die advacc advanced accounting GmbH ist der Partner für moderne, vollständig digitale Buchhaltung mit Standorten in Düsseldorf und Greifswald. Als externe Buchhaltung übernehmen wir für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zentrale Aufgaben der Finanzbuchhaltung, von der Bearbeitung von Ein- und Ausgangsrechnungen über die Buchung aller Geschäftsvorfälle bis zur Lohnabrechnung und stellen fristgerechte, transparente und rechtssichere Abläufe sicher.
Darüber hinaus beraten wir betriebswirtschaftlich, steuern das Forderungsmanagement und treiben die Digitalisierung sowie Optimierung von Buchhaltungsprozessen voran. Unser erfahrenes Team arbeitet softwareunabhängig, schnell und proaktiv, mit dem Anspruch, Abläufe zu vereinfachen, Liquidität zu sichern und Freiräume für das Kerngeschäft unserer Kundinnen und Kunden zu schaffen. About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Role
Do you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting web and front end developers based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a web or front end developer. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. 

Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.

The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can.

What you’ll be doing

  • Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant
  • Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences
  • Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective
  • Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part

What you’ll bring

  • Residence in the UK
  • Fluent English
  • A device with a working microphone
  • No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population.

Why join this project?
This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own Pricing within our Growth team across Deliveroo and Wolt! This role operates across 40+ markets in EMEA, and sits at the heart of our marketplace: Our fee strategy directly shapes consumer conversion, order frequency, PnL outcomes - and connects deeply to rider earnings and merchant economics across the Globe. You'll be responsible for building a pricing strategy and experimentation roadmap that grows revenue and profitability sustainably, without compromising the customer experience.

This is a very high-visibility role. You'll partner closely with Leadership, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to design, launch, and iterate on pricing experiments across all markets, from delivery fee and service fee algorithms to 0-1 new ventures. You'll be expected to build a strong testing culture, translate ambiguous commercial questions into a rigorous experimentation agenda, and communicate results and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders. 

About the Team

Our ambition is simple: make our platform an affordable, daily habit for all users.

The Pricing team builds the systems and experiences that touch every single order — from delivery options to promotions, fees, and entirely new pricing models. Operating across 40+ markets, our work sits at the intersection of customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.

Small changes at this scale can change how customers perceive us, how often they order, and the economics of the entire marketplace. We bring together consumer psychology, experimentation, data science, economics, and product craft to answer one deceptively difficult question: How do we make every order feel like great value while driving sustainable growth?

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of global pricing products.
  • Identify and launch major growth opportunities across affordability, conversion, frequency, revenue, and profitability.
  • Drive 0 to 1 big bets through validation, launch, then scale them 100X.
  • Partner deeply with Data Science and ML Engineering to design pricing algorithms, experiments, and scalable platform capabilities.
  • Develop hypotheses, launch experiments, interpret results, and turn learnings into product strategy.
  • Define the metrics and decision frameworks used to evaluate customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.
  • Communicate strategy, results, and tradeoffs to senior leaders across DoorDash.

What We’re Looking For

You might be a great fit if you:

  • Have significant product management experience building complex consumer, marketplace, growth, or monetization products.
  • Are deeply analytical and comfortable using experimentation and data to make high-stakes product decisions.
  • Are comfortable working closely with Data Science and ML Engineering on algorithmic or optimization problems.
  • Can turn ambiguous commercial questions into clear and executable product hypotheses and roadmaps.
  • Can operate as a “conductor” — aligning technical, operational, and business stakeholders and stitching together strategy, execution, and influence across teams.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo and Wolt, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Why Deliveroo (part of DoorDash)

Deliveroo, part of the DoorDash group, is building the leading local commerce platform, connecting consumers, merchants, and couriers in real time. Paris is one of our most strategic and complex markets globally, with unmatched density, brand concentration, and competitive intensity.

As we move towards our 2026 ambition, we are evolving our commercial organisation to match the scale and sophistication required to win in Paris. This includes increased seniority, clearer regional ownership, and stronger execution across Inner and Outer Paris.

The Senior Client Partner – Paris Inner Ouest role is a newly strengthened position, designed to combine strategic partner leadership, regional ownership, and organisation building.

The Role

As a Senior Client Partner, you'll lead a team of Account Management Lead, Senior Account Manager and Account Manager and you will report to the Regional Director of Paris, part of the Commercial team. The position is based in Paris. 

You are accountable for the growth and performance of strategic brand portfolios across one of Paris’ most critical zones. You will act as the senior commercial owner for your territory, ensuring alignment between Paris-wide strategy and local execution. Beyond partner management, this role plays a central part in aligning the organisation to business challenges and ambitions. You will design, lead, and continuously evolve the account management setup to ensure the right level of seniority, coverage, and execution quality across the territory. 

This is a senior leadership role with direct impact on revenue, partner satisfaction, and team development.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Commercial Strategy & Execution Excellence 

  • Own the end-to-end growth of brand portfolios within your Paris Inner cluster

  • Ensure 5★ account management standards across the team, with clear portfolio sizing

  • Build and maintain relationships with senior and C-level stakeholders

  • Lead contract negotiations, renewals, and upsell strategies

  • Create and execute joint business plans addressing partner growth, profitability, and operational performance

  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing insights on Deliveroo capabilities, competitors, and market trends

  • Responsible for a commercial initiative for Paris : engage team, drive performance and proactively adjust structure, focus, or processes

2. Regional & Portfolio Ownership

  • Own a zone cluster, defining and executing the strategy to win

  • Translate Paris-wide and national priorities into clear, actionable regional strategies

  • Improve Client Value Proposition (CVP) across the territory in collaboration with other commercial departments

3. Talent Development & Succession

  • Lead and develop a team of up to 10 AMs / SAMs, either directly or through mid-management

  • Coach and mentor high-potential talent, building a strong internal succession pipeline

4. Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Operations, Marketing, Product, Strategy, and Finance

  • Represent your portfolio and organisation in Paris and France leadership forums

  • Influence roadmap and prioritisation through structured partner and market feedback

What We’re Looking For

Experience

  • 10+ years in commercial, client partnership, or account management roles
  • Proven experience managing complex, strategic brand portfolios
  • Demonstrated success leading multi-layered teams in fast-paced environments
  • Experience in F&B, Hospitality, Retail, FMCG, or Marketplace businesses preferred
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen (P&L understanding)
  • Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to design and scale organisations and coverage models
  • Data-driven, structured, and execution-focused
  • Senior, credible, and resilient leader
  • High ownership mindset with a bias for action
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving change
  • Passionate about people development and raising standards

Life at Deliveroo

At Deliveroo, you’ll work on some of the most complex and impactful challenges in local commerce. We move fast, value ownership, and believe that strong teams build great outcomes.

This role offers significant scope, visibility, and influence in shaping how Deliveroo wins in Paris.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.
