raw.description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The Role

We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion.

This is a hands-on builder role, not a traditional RevOps support function. You'll work like a product engineer for GTM: find the biggest constraint on growth, turn a messy commercial problem into a working system, ship it quickly and improve it using real results. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be able to build with Salesforce, Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools rather than waiting for someone else to do it.

You'll also be Kernel's own internal customer, using Kernel to build an AI-native revenue engine, pressure-test the product in real workflows and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering.

You'll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations, and work closely with Sales leadership and the wider GTM team.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build a better outbound engine: improve account targeting, signals, enrichment, prioritization, personalization, sequencing and measurement so the team consistently reaches the right companies at the right time

  • Make the GTM team more productive: automate repetitive work across account research, meeting preparation, follow-ups, CRM hygiene and handoffs so BDRs, AEs and Account Managers spend more time with customers

  • Run the revenue operating infrastructure: own the systems behind pipeline management, forecasting, funnel reporting, quota planning, GTM incentive compensation, renewals and expansion

  • Set the rules of engagement: own account assignment and routing, settle ownership disputes, and make sure every meeting booked and held is captured and credited to the right person

  • Improve how revenue work moves through Kernel: build reliable routing, attribution, account assignment and cross-functional handoffs, resolve edge cases and make performance visible

  • Be Kernel's own internal customer: deploy Kernel on our CRM, use it to improve our GTM data and workflows, and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering

What You Bring

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience: you have worked in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM Engineering at a high-growth Series B-E SaaS company and owned meaningful parts of the revenue engine end to end

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: you understand objects, record types, fields, formulas, flows, validation rules, permissions, reports and data migration. You can reason about architecture and debug production behavior

  • Strong GTM building ability: you have built useful systems with Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools, and you know how to move from a rough idea to a reliable workflow that people adopt

  • Commercial judgment: you understand how accounts become meetings, meetings become pipeline, pipeline is qualified and forecast, and won revenue flows into implementation, expansion, renewal and retention

  • Strong data instincts: you can turn fragmented information into trustworthy workflows, measure what is working and create feedback loops that improve performance over time

  • Clear, low-ego communication: you can turn a messy request into a crisp decision, explain trade-offs to non-technical teams, push back constructively and drive adoption through influence rather than authority

It is a plus if you also have:

  • Experience supporting an enterprise sales motion with multi-stakeholder deals and MEDDPICC

  • Experience with renewals, expansion, compensation, quota setting or planning

  • Familiarity with Gong, sales engagement platforms and modern enrichment or intent tooling

  • Experience building operational controls around LLM- or agent-powered workflows

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Prefer strategy and recommendations over configuring systems, cleaning data, investigating edge cases and debugging workflows yourself

  • Need outlined requirements or stable priorities before you can make progress

  • See GTM Engineering primarily as CRM administration or ticket fulfillment rather than a revenue-generating function

❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:

  • Are not comfortable taking broad ownership of a function

  • Prefer a predictable, low-intensity environment

  • Want to protect a 9-to-6 or a mostly remote setup. We are in the office together 4-5 days a week and the pace is high

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 💰 Salary: £70,000-£90,000 + equity

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

  • 🥕 £450 monthly office dinner allowance

  • ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

  • 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

  • 💼 Pension plan

  • 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

  • 🎉 Team events and dinners

  • 🚀 Work directly with the founders to build the systems that power an AI-native revenue engine

  • 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

❤️ Team

Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations

Amin Shafi, BizOps Associate

Dave Bentham, Head of Sales

🎫 Visas & Relocation

Not offered for this role.

Interview Process

  • Stage 1: Screening: Intro call

  • Stage 2: Technical: In-person case interview

  • Stage 3: Coffee chat: In-person discussion with members of our GTM team

  • Final stage: Values: Interview with founders for culture and values alignment

If there is mutual fit, we move to references and offer.

title: Staff Front End Engineer
description: Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid) The Mission: Why We Exist Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer, healthier lives, using the power of genomics. Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time. Role Purpose Genomics turns large-scale genetic and health data into insight that speeds up drug discovery and helps people understand their risk of disease. None of it matters if people can’t explore it, trust it and act on it. Being qualified in both England & Wales and the US means you can cover our two largest legal systems directly and coordinate local counsel everywhere else.

What you will own

This role spans four pillars. As the role is fractional, focus matters a lot: you will prioritise what only a senior lawyer can do, bring in external support where it makes sense, and build the tools that let the business help itself.

1. Commercial contracting & client advice

  • Reviewing and negotiating our priority client agreements: MSAs, SOWs and framework agreements under English and US law

  • Drafting key partner, vendor, and supplier agreements

  • Advising clients and internal teams on cross-border matters across EMEA, the Americas, and APAC

  • Setting clear positions on liability, IP ownership, and data terms, so deals keep moving

2. Governance, risk & compliance

  • Flagging the legal risks that matter most and recommending priorities to the COO and Exec team;

  • Oversight of corporate governance and entity matters across our 7 legal entities, working with local advisers;

  • Supporting the Exec team and board matters when legal input is needed;

  • Keeping our compliance posture current, including anti-bribery, sanctions, and export controls.

3. Data, AI & intellectual property

  • Data protection and privacy across the UK, EU and US, including DPAs and international transfers;

  • Guidance on AI regulation, including the EU AI Act, as it applies to our services;

  • Protecting our intellectual property, including our flagship product, Flowline.

4. Building the legal foundations

  • Contract templates, negotiation playbooks and approval rules for routine matters;

  • A simple intake and tracking process so everyone knows what is in progress;

  • Selecting and managing external counsel for specialist or local-law work, within budget;

  • Helping shape the scope of a future full-time legal hire if and when we need one.

Who you are

We are not looking for a particular CV but for a particular kind of lawyer, namely senior, commercial, honest, and genuinely interested in the work our teams do.

Experience that matters

  • Qualified as a solicitor in England & Wales and the US (preferrably), with both qualifications current and in good standing;

  • 7+ years' PQE, with training at a leading law firm and in-house experience, ideally in technology, data, AI or professional services;

  • A track record of working fractionally, as an interim, or as a consultant lawyer, and of making an impact quickly;

  • Strong commercial contracting experience, especially services, technology and SaaS agreements;

  • Experience advising on cross-border matters across the UK, EU, and US, with exposure to APAC a plus;

  • Working knowledge of data protection, IP, and emerging AI regulation;

  • Experience setting up legal processes or being a company's first legal adviser;

  • Your own professional indemnity insurance, or cover through your platform or consultancy.

Your approach

  • You prioritise ruthlessly and are clear about what can wait;

  • You give clear answers and a recommendation, not a list of risks;

  • You build trust with clients, colleagues and leadership because you are straight with them;

  • You leave things better documented than you found them, so the business is never stuck waiting for you;

  • You bring rigour without bureaucracy. Life is too short for red tape;

  • You are aligned with our company values. This matters to us.

How the engagement works

  • 10 days a month with flexibility around specific working hours and with reasonable availability for urgent matters outside of those;

  • A shared request channel and a simple tracker so priorities are visible to everyone;

  • A regular check-in with the COO to review workload, priorities and whether the agreed working days still fit;

  • Additional days agreed in advance, at the same day rate.

Why work with us

  • Being your true self: show up as you are. We work with people for character, not conformity;

  • Practising innovation: front-row seat to the rapid evolution of data and AI, and the legal questions that come with it;

  • Living autonomously: remote-first, with flexibility on how you structure your days;

  • Real influence: a senior voice in a growing global business, working directly with the COO and Exec team.

We are a Certified B Corporation. That means we measure ourselves not just by what we deliver, but by how we deliver it because of our people, our clients, our communities, and the environment.

Our Legal Counsel will help make sure that commitment is reflected in how we contract and govern ourselves.

  • Engagement: Fractional, initial term of 12 months with the option to extend;

  • Contract: Consultancy agreement, directly, through your own company, or through a fractional legal platform; IR35 status assessed before contracting;

  • Location: Remote-first / UK / US;

  • Reports to: COO;

  • Key partnerships: CEO, CTO, CFO, and other Exec team members; General Managers, Sales and Partnership leads, Head of People / HR;

  1. Application review

  2. Screening conversation with our Talent Acquisition team

  3. Interview with the COO and CTO/CEO

  4. Technical interview with one of our legal advisors

▶ ▶ Submit your CV in English in PDF, with your day rate, availability, and preferred engagement route.

▶ ▶ Mind that as we are an international team, internal communication is in English.

▶ ▶ We will verify your qualifications on the SRA register and the relevant US state bar register before your first interview.

▶ ▶ To ensure legislative compliance, applicants may be asked to provide up-to-date proof of a clean criminal record, such as a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check (UK) or a country-specific equivalent. This is the final step in the process and will only be requested once terms are agreed.

Infinite Lambda is an equal opportunity organisation. Our inclusive culture celebrates diversity and treats everyone with dignity and respect. Accordingly, our selection process will never discriminate against applicants on the grounds of any characteristics, such as disability, age, gender, sexual orientation, family status, race, faith or other.

About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakeholders directly involved in the model development and deployment. Moreover, in this senior role, it is vital that you can mentor other team members, own the technical processes and actively contribute to the ML roadmap. Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow), data modeling (dbt) and working in a regulated and/or medical environment are a plus! What you will do Drive the full ML model development lifecycle: from understanding and co-defining the problem to providing inputs on data collection, assessing the quality of data, model training, validation, deployment and monitoring. Hands-on expertise with modern deep learning architectures and other ML architectures, ideally but not restricted to image data. Proven ability to thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines. Experience with mentoring and leading team members. Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision

We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. title: Business Development Intern
description: Big changes start with people who want to achieve more. How do employees get to work? Why do company cars sit idle while parking spaces are scarce? And how can we make sustainable mobility the most attractive choice? At Urban Connect , we turn these challenges into practical solutions. We bring shared e-bikes and company cars, public transport, mobility budgets and digital parking management together on one platform. We help companies reduce costs, make better use of resources and give their employees greater freedom. Companies such as Roche, Google, SWISS and Lonza already rely on us. Our ambition goes further: we want to transform how companies manage mobility. To make that happen, we are looking for curious minds who take ownership and want to make a difference together. Your internship: accelerated learning, real responsibility Want to understand how a technology company grows—and help make it happen? During this six-month internship, you will work closely with our Sales and Account Management team, as well as Product and Operations. You will learn to understand customer needs, develop compelling solutions and turn data into tangible business opportunities. Your initiative matters. You will contribute your own ideas, take on increasing responsibility and see the impact of your work. How you will make a difference Turn data into opportunities: analyse usage and market data, including vehicle and parking utilisation, and translate your findings into recommendations for better corporate mobility solutions. Drive your own projects: Work with the team lead to take ownership of clearly defined projects, such as analysing products, assessing sales opportunities and developing corporate mobility concepts. Understand the product: learn how customers are set up on our platform, how bookings and billing work, and how vehicles and parking barriers are connected. Work smarter with AI: use AI tools thoughtfully, test new applications and help us improve research, analysis and everyday processes. Help drive growth: identify prospective customers, research their challenges and support the team in winning new business and expanding existing partnerships. Make a compelling case: create clear presentations, well-founded proposals and insightful quarterly reviews that demonstrate the value of our solutions. Keep things moving: maintain accurate customer data and activities in HubSpot, ensuring good conversations lead to clear next steps. Connect teams: resolve technical questions with the Product, Operations and Technology teams and communicate the answers clearly to customers and the Commercial team. What you bring An excellent degree, for example in business, economics, data science, engineering or industrial engineering. We are looking for excellence, curiosity, creativity and courage - not to have studied a perfect subject. Some practical experience through an internship, part-time job, personal project or entrepreneurial initiative. An analytical mindset, confidence with Excel and the ability to understand and communicate complex ideas and interdependencies clearly and simply. Ability to think outside of the box and to question conventional ways of doing things. Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot - and the excellent judgement to critically assess their output. In fact, good judgment is a key criterion for success with us. An interest in technological progress, the curiosity to truly understand how things work, and the confidence to contribute your questions and ideas to a highly motivated team. Excellent German and good English skills. French is a big plus. Above all, we value your mindset: you learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and think ahead. You take initiative, develop suggestions and seek support when you need it. You care about the details, strive to make good work even better and are willing to take a risk sometimes to try something new - even when that means making a mistake and learning from it. What you can expect High standards - and an environment of smart, kind people to challenge you to grow. We are ambitious, give direct, constructive feedback and support one another. Excellence shows up in our everyday work: in thoughtful solutions, careful execution and the drive to keep improving. A view of the whole business. You will work at the intersection of sales, customer success, technology and operations, learning how an idea becomes a solution that customers value. Direct access and room to take initiative. Good ideas get heard quickly here. Your responsibility grows with your capabilities and commitment. The opportunity to build a future with us. If we are a good fit for each other, there is an opportunity to join Urban Connect beyond the internship and grow with the company. You will also benefit from: Flexible working hours and a beautiful office in Zurich. A monthly mobility budget and access to our e-bikes and shared electric cars. A motivated team that enjoys working together (mostly in person), sharing knowledge, growing together, and celebrating success together! Ready to make a difference? Send us your CV and a few personal lines: Why Urban Connect? And what are you proud of having initiated, solved or improved yourself? We look forward to meeting you. title: Engineering Director (100% Remote within Poland)
description: Build the AI-native healthcare journey Every month, around 100 million people come to Docplanner to find a doctor, book a visit, stay in touch with their care and pay for it. Each of those steps is now being reinvented with AI. Search is turning into conversation. Booking is becoming something an agent can do for you. Payments that once needed a human to step in are starting to resolve themselves. Ongoing care is moving from reminders to proactive, personal follow-up. We're looking for an Engineering Director to lead that change across Marketplace, Patient Engagement and Payments . It's the part of Docplanner that most patients see and much of what providers depend on. You'll lead around 75 engineers and turn three strong areas into one connected, intelligent patient experience. Our mission is to help people live longer, healthier lives. We use AI to do that in a way that patients and doctors can trust. Why this role, why now Most engineering leaders are still deciding what AI means for their teams. Here, you get to answer that question at a real scale, in a regulated domain where quality, privacy and trust come first. You'll shape two things at once: What we build: AI-powered discovery, booking, engagement and payment experiences for patients and providers in 13 markets. How we build it: an engineering organisation where AI-assisted development is simply how work gets done, from writing code to testing and review, with the discipline to know when it helps and when it doesn't. What you'll do Set the direction. Own the engineering strategy and roadmap across all three areas. Tie technical bets to product outcomes and to numbers that move. Build product builders. Build a strong engineering team that thinks in terms of value. Make ownership clear, strengthen the leadership bench and give teams room to decide without waiting on each other. Turn AI into a product. Work with Product and Design from discovery through delivery to bring AI into search, booking, engagement, continuity of care and payments, where it solves real patient and provider problems. Continue rewiring how engineering works. We already made a transformation in terms of AI-assisted development across coding, testing and review. We want to go further and need you to set the standards for checking AI output and protecting quality, security and privacy, so moving faster never means being careless. Own the architecture. Guide design and engineering standards across the portfolio, balancing pace with reliability, security, privacy and scale across markets. Remove friction at its source. Improve how ideas become impact with clear priorities, a few useful measures and regular learning. Fix recurring problems at the root and keep the process light. Shape company-wide tech. Align with engineering peers on shared platforms, explain trade-offs to executives and help make technology decisions across Docplanner. You are hands-on This isn’t a role where you lead from slides. You use AI coding tools yourself, take part in design and code reviews, and quickly prototype solutions when it helps unblock a hard problem. That technical credibility supports your leadership, while most of your impact comes through the people you develop. What you bring Experience leading multi-team engineering organisations through managers , with a record of growing leaders and delivering through change. raw.jobDescription:
Build the AI-native healthcare journey

Every month, around 100 million people come to Docplanner to find a doctor, book a visit, stay in touch with their care and pay for it. Each of those steps is now being reinvented with AI.

Search is turning into conversation. Booking is becoming something an agent can do for you. Payments that once needed a human to step in are starting to resolve themselves. Ongoing care is moving from reminders to proactive, personal follow-up.

We're looking for an Engineering Director to lead that change across Marketplace, Patient Engagement and Payments. It's the part of Docplanner that most patients see and much of what providers depend on. You'll lead around 75 engineers and turn three strong areas into one connected, intelligent patient experience.

Our mission is to help people live longer, healthier lives. We use AI to do that in a way that patients and doctors can trust.

Why this role, why now

Most engineering leaders are still deciding what AI means for their teams. Here, you get to answer that question at a real scale, in a regulated domain where quality, privacy and trust come first.

You'll shape two things at once:

  • What we build: AI-powered discovery, booking, engagement and payment experiences for patients and providers in 13 markets.

  • How we build it: an engineering organisation where AI-assisted development is simply how work gets done, from writing code to testing and review, with the discipline to know when it helps and when it doesn't.

What you'll do

  • Set the direction. Own the engineering strategy and roadmap across all three areas. Tie technical bets to product outcomes and to numbers that move.

  • Build product builders. Build a strong engineering team that thinks in terms of value. Make ownership clear, strengthen the leadership bench and give teams room to decide without waiting on each other.

  • Turn AI into a product. Work with Product and Design from discovery through delivery to bring AI into search, booking, engagement, continuity of care and payments, where it solves real patient and provider problems.

  • Continue rewiring how engineering works. We already made a transformation in terms of AI-assisted development across coding, testing and review. We want to go further and need you to set the standards for checking AI output and protecting quality, security and privacy, so moving faster never means being careless.

  • Own the architecture. Guide design and engineering standards across the portfolio, balancing pace with reliability, security, privacy and scale across markets.

  • Remove friction at its source. Improve how ideas become impact with clear priorities, a few useful measures and regular learning. Fix recurring problems at the root and keep the process light.

  • Shape company-wide tech. Align with engineering peers on shared platforms, explain trade-offs to executives and help make technology decisions across Docplanner.

You are hands-on

This isn’t a role where you lead from slides. You use AI coding tools yourself, take part in design and code reviews, and quickly prototype solutions when it helps unblock a hard problem. That technical credibility supports your leadership, while most of your impact comes through the people you develop.

What you bring

  • Experience leading multi-team engineering organisations through managers, with a record of growing leaders and delivering through change.

  • Daily, practical fluency with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or whatever you prefer) and clear judgment about its strengths, limits and risks. You don't need a deep ML background; you need to have changed how you and your teams work.

  • A product mindset: you connect engineering strategy to customer outcomes and business results, and you care whether what you ship gets used.

  • Technical depth across architecture, delivery, reliability and security, and you're comfortable going into the details.

  • Strong partnership skills with Product, Design, Data and business leaders, and you're calm with executives and with ambiguity.

  • Experience with marketplaces and complex, high-stakes products where reliability, privacy and security matter.

What success looks like in your first year

  • Marketplace, Patient Engagement and Payments work to share priorities and one engineering direction tied to product strategy.

  • AI features live in the patient journey, and product data shows where they help patients and providers.

  • AI-assisted engineering is the default where it adds value, and teams measure what it does for speed, quality and developer experience.

  • Engineering managers have clear ownership and the tools to lead delivery, people growth and technical decisions on their own.

  • A small set of useful delivery and quality metrics shows where the bottlenecks are and drives better reliability.

Why Docplanner

You'll work on real problems for real people: 100 million patients a month and more than 300,000 doctors who depend on what you ship. You'll do it at a company that treats AI as central to how it builds products, not as an add-on.

True flexibility and work-life balance

title: Technical Product Manager - Production Data Storage (x/f/m)
description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the DODO team in the Platform domain.
Your mission will be to build and maintain the common building blocks of Doctolib's system with a "Platform as a Product" mindset, abstracting and simplifying complex, critical data infrastructure so that product teams can focus on what matters: building faster, better products for healthcare professionals and patients. You will work closely with 600+ engineers across 70+ teams, owning the vision and strategy for data management products that form the foundation of everything we build.
Working in the product team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We operate in feature teams within an agile environment, collaborating closely with engineering, design, and business teams.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Own and align the 2-year vision for data storage at Doctolib, defining which datastore products we build, which we source off the shelf, and how they serve both the monolith and the growing ecosystem of services around it
  • Define the product strategy and roadmap for data management products used by 600+ engineers, spanning multiple datastores (PostgreSQL/Aurora, Kafka, Debezium, Couchbase), file storage, data access, and data lifecycle solutions
  • Drive reliability, recoverability, and cost transparency across teams, including SLOs, alert ownership, backup and restore testing, and per-team cost visibility
  • Define the experience for managing production data for services outside the monolith and for new AI product storage needs
  • Partner with Staff and Senior Staff Engineers to assess the impact of complex architectural decisions, facilitate consensus across diverse viewpoints, and align stakeholders on contested trade-offs
  • Measure and improve engineer satisfaction with data management products, leading projects end-to-end, from problem definition and specs writing to development validation, rollout, and impact follow-up

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.
You'll be a great fit if you:
  • Have at least 5 years of experience in Product Management with direct product ownership, working with developers, leading rituals, and writing specifications
  • Have extensive experience with technical products and platforms, and a passion for solving complex, large-scale infrastructure challenges
  • Can drive change across large engineering organizations, you're comfortable influencing 600+ engineers across more than 70 teams
  • Have proven experience building and launching products in a large-scale, international B2B environment, where moving fast without slowing down feature development is a constant challenge
  • Are fluent in both English and French (C1 level minimum) and are comfortable working in an international environment
  • Have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ambition to transform healthcare

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children
  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT
  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib
  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class
  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription
  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib
  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth
  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support
  • Relocation support in case of international mobility
  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • Recruiter Interview (45m) - w Maxime
  • Hiring Manager Interview (60m) - w Loïc 
  • Live-case Interview (90m) 
  • Behavioral Interview (75m)
  • At least one reference check
We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position
  • Full-time
  • Paris, France
  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)
  • Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.
The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.
To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.
Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

raw.jobDescription:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Software Engineer.

About the job

This position will be part of a team of talented engineers within our Commerce Platform Team, who build services and products that operate at a massive scale. This platform is central to Twilio's core business as it is responsible for managing the billing lifecycle and payment experience for our customers, while also acting as a gateway for discovering and selling our products. Billing is going through a transformational journey, and we are introducing new and exciting capabilities. The engineer in this role will be part of a team that focuses on the control plane, billing experience and account lifecycle management.

The successful candidate will design, build, and operate core billing platform services that help transition our platform and our customers to the next generation architecture. These services work for all Twilio customers, regardless of their scale and billing complexity.

The ideal candidate will build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software that complies with high levels of coding standards and technical design. This is to build and integrate services that continuously improve our ability to provide products to customers while simultaneously delivering industry leading availability. We do this by leveraging technologies that include AWS cloud infrastructure and APIs, Apache Kafka, Rest APIs (OpenAPI compliance), while also building our own services.


Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Improve your knowledge of highly available and scalable distributed systems and use this knowledge to build new features into our platform.
  • Design, implement, and operate both new features on our current services as well as new services that will be built from scratch.
  • Leverage your excellent communication and written skills to articulate the "why" of the solution you are proposing, and have a good understanding of your team’s priorities and the customer impact.
  • Troubleshoot and fix operational issues and have the opportunity to improve the troubleshooting procedures and tools.
  • Execute full software development life cycle (SDLC).
  • Develop flowcharts and documentation to identify solutions.
  • Write well-designed, testable code.
  • Document and maintain software functionality.
  • Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade existing systems.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

As a Commerce Platform engineer, you will design and build core platform services, REST APIs and take part in transitioning our platform to next generation architecture. We run on AWS cloud infrastructure and use AWS cloud data store, EKS, Glue, Kafka, Aurora RDS etc.


*Required:

  • 5+ years of work experience building highly scalable products.
  • 5+ years of programming experience in object-oriented language (Java or similar) with clean code practices.
  • Expert knowledge in Object-Oriented Programming with a successful track record.
  • Experience contributing to architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems.
  • Experience working closely with our Product team to understand requirements and help to define technical work for the team.
  • Experience working with stakeholders at all levels - be able to dive into the nuts-and-bolts of how things work as needed.
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases.
  • Experience delivering high levels of observability and proficiency in improving early warning systems, for example: has worked with Grafana/DataDog/Prometheus.
  • Collaborating with internal/external teams/engineers and fostering an inclusive environment, where all points of view are welcomed and encouraged.
  • Own and lead multiple domains of the platform (microservices, REST APIs, infrastructure) from inception to deployment and maintenance, while making best in class technical decisions that impact the success of the company.
  • Familiarity in Cloud Solutions, AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD pipelines, Testing & Automation.
  • Self driven - you take complete ownership of your tasks and champion efforts to get your tasks to completion.
  • Clear written and spoken communication skills.
  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Desired:

  • Experience with on-call support for mission-critical customer systems.
  • Experience optimizing and debugging complex SQL queries.
  • Experience working on customer-facing applications.
  • Good debugging skills on production systems.
  • Proficient in Linux and containerization with Kubernetes.
  • Nice to have skills: gRPC, Python, Typescript, React, Apache Kafka.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. .

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Golang Software Engineer at any seniority level, who strives for the highest engineering quality, seeks improvements, continuously develops their skills, and applies them at work. This is an exciting opportunity to work with many popular software systems, integrations technologies, and exciting open-source solutions. The Commercial Systems unit is conceived as six engineering teams that closely collaborate with other engineering and business teams at Canonical. This team is an excellent match for any software engineer interested in understanding sales and revenue processes and growing their skills beyond software engineering. The Livepatch team designs and develops a service for the delivery of Linux kernel patches to shrink the exploit window for critical and high severity Linux kernel vulnerabilities, by patching the Linux kernel between security maintenance windows, while the system runs. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based client and backend components, while another Canonical team, the Kernel team, develops the security patches. This team is a great opportunity for a software engineer interested in security and with a strong focus on engineering quality and reliability. Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Employee Assistance Program Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Establish clear boundaries and interfaces between operational systems, data platforms, analytics layers, and downstream applications. Facilitate technical discussions that turn ambiguous requirements into durable, well-reasoned solutions. Create and maintain architecture decision records, reference architectures, roadmaps, and technical standards that provide clarity across teams. Influence leaders and stakeholders through concise communication of technical options, risks, tradeoffs, and recommended paths forward. Optimize data systems for reliability, usability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. Ensure data products are designed with clear ownership, documentation, lineage, quality expectations, and support models. Lead architecture reviews, technical workshops, design sessions, and knowledge-sharing forums. Establish reusable templates, reference implementations, and playbooks that improve consistency and accelerate delivery. Foster an inclusive, high-accountability engineering culture centered on thoughtful collaboration, continuous learning, and ownership. Act as a technical multiplier: helping teams make better decisions independently while maintaining alignment with shared architectural principles. What you bring Required 10+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or a related technical discipline. 5+ years designing and operating large-scale data platforms, distributed data systems, or enterprise-grade data products. Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end system design, including defining requirements, evaluating tradeoffs, designing resilient architectures, and delivering production systems. Deep experience with modern data architecture concepts, such as lakehouse or warehouse platforms, batch and streaming processing, data modeling, orchestration, metadata management, and data governance. Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or similar. Experience with distributed data processing frameworks and technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or equivalent platforms. Strong knowledge of data modeling practices across analytical, operational, and domain-oriented use cases. Experience establishing engineering standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, infrastructure as code, reliability, and security. Proven ability to lead technical decisions across multiple teams without relying on direct authority. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and raising technical standards across an organization. Preferred Experience with cloud-native data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience implementing data mesh, domain-oriented data product, or self-service platform patterns. Familiarity with data governance, cataloging, lineage, privacy, and access-control tooling. Experience supporting financial, revenue, operational, customer, or enterprise analytics domains. Experience with ML data pipelines, feature stores, or AI/LLM data foundations. Experience managing major data-platform migrations, modernization programs, or large-scale architectural transformations. Leadership Competencies Systems thinker : Connects individual technical decisions to broader platform, organizational, and business outcomes. Builder and operator : Designs for production from the beginning, including reliability, security, observability, and supportability. title: Lead Backend Engineer, Service Standards
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Lead Backend Engineer in the Service Standards team, you will shape how services are built, deployed, and operated across all of Vinted. You will work closely with a team on the development of our core service framework—providing engineering teams with golden paths, robust service contracts, standardized tooling, and performance benchmarks to ensure high reliability and developer velocity at scale.


You will sit in the Service Standards team, part of the Service Ecosystem domain, reporting to the Engineering Manager of that team.


The Service Standards team is responsible for standardizing service startup, consumer APIs, and foundational backend frameworks across Vinted's engineering landscape. Within it, this is a senior individual-contributor role combining technical leadership with high autonomy—you will define architectural directions, establish best practices, and guide engineers across domains without requiring full management overhead.


You will collaborate closely with platform, observability, and product engineering teams to ensure our service framework and standards seamlessly integrate into daily workflows. Your work will directly impact developer experience, platform reliability, and system performance as Vinted continues to scale.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Lead the technical direction and design around service standards and golden paths.
  • Define and evolve company-wide service standards, including consumer APIs, service contracts, startup routines, and performance guidelines.
  • Build reusable backend libraries, tools, and scaffolding to streamline new service creation and maintenance.
  • Partner with backend engineers across domains to drive adoption of framework updates and gather continuous feedback.
  • Evaluate pragmatic trade-offs between architectural consistency, delivery speed, and technical debt across the platform.
  • Collaborate with Observability and Infrastructure teams to integrate telemetry, SLOs, and resilience practices into standard service templates.
  • Ensure security, privacy, and compliance guidelines are embedded directly into service contracts and framework templates.
  • Mentor senior backend engineers, participate in architectural design reviews, and foster high engineering standards across teams.
  • Drive architectural proposals (RFCs/ADRs) for platform-wide backend standardization.

About you 

  • Have deep backend engineering experience and strong architectural intuition, with proven success building scalable services and frameworks.
  • Demonstrate a track record of driving cross-team technical alignment and leading complex initiatives across multiple engineering groups.
  • Possess expert knowledge in designing API contracts, service startup patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Understand trade-offs in platform design and know how to build golden paths that engineers love to use.
  • Communicate technical vision and architectural choices clearly to both technical leads and engineering leadership.
  • Enjoy mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and sharing best practices to level up the backend engineering community.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance 
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:
€93.500—€126.500 EUR

title: Senior Manager, Commercial Sales (South)
description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Manager, Commercial Sales, you will lead and inspire a team of Commercial Sales Representatives covering diverse markets and segments across Southern EMEA, driving results through hands-on coaching, strategic pipeline management, and a relentless focus on exceeding targets. You will combine deep commercial expertise with a passion for developing people, building the programs, partnerships, and team culture needed to sustain high performance in a fast-moving, competitive cybersecurity market. If you are a creative self-starter who thrives on both leading from the front and investing in the success of those around you, this role is for you.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Lead, expand, and coach a team of Commercial Sales Representatives covering multiple Southern EMEA markets and segments — providing the resources, training, and day-to-day guidance needed to consistently achieve and exceed targets, including active call shadowing and ad hoc feedback sessions.
  • Execute and supervise end-to-end sales activities including prospecting, lead follow-up, opportunity qualification, proof of concept management, commercial negotiation, and deal closure, while proactively managing the team’s funnel to ensure both quantity and quality of opportunities are on track for quota attainment.
  • Conduct and execute quarterly business plans, create and develop new programs and campaigns in conjunction with Marketing and Sales, and design incentive plans and SPIFFs that foster a competitive, collaborative, and high-energy team environment — operating with confidence and limited guidance.
  • Set accurate business expectations and maintain clear communication with senior sales management, measuring and reporting against KPIs and creating ad hoc reports as needed, while maintaining a thorough working knowledge of SentinelOne’s full product capabilities.
  • Assist in recruiting, hiring, and onboarding top commercial sales talent, and invest deeply in the growth and long-term success of each team member through mentoring, career development, and a genuine commitment to both individual and collective goal attainment.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • Proven sales management experience in a B2B SaaS environment, with a track record of exceeding goals as both an individual contributor and a team leader — cybersecurity or endpoint security experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working in an indirect, two-tier go-to-market model that includes channel partners and distributors, with a solid understanding of how to maximize reach and performance through partner ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and lead highly skilled, motivated, and results-oriented commercial sales teams, with a passion for coaching and mentoring emerging sales talent and experience delivering both positive and constructive feedback that drives real growth.
  • Exceptional communication skills — verbal, written, and presentation — combined with strong interpersonal skills, a customer-focused mindset, and the organizational ability to create and track individual and team metrics with precision.
  • A creative, “roll-up-the-sleeves” self-starter attitude with the energy to thrive in a fast-paced, continuously evolving environment, and the ability to inspire a collaborative team culture focused on collective lead generation and quota attainment.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

title: Principal Software Engineer
description: NetDocuments is committed to providing an excellent candidate experience and will never ask you to engage in recruitment activity without phone, video, and in person meetings and communications from emails using the @netdocuments.com domain. If you have any concerns or questions about communications you have received, please send them to hrgroup@netdocuments.com so our team members can review. About NetDocuments At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. We believe legal professionals should spend less time searching for information and managing documents, and more time solving complex problems, serving clients, and delivering meaningful outcomes. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge. Our team is redefining what's possible for legal technology. NetDocuments is the trusted intelligent document management platform for legal professionals and the company behind the industry's first and only legal context graph—a breakthrough that gives legal professionals and AI a richer understanding of how matters, documents, people, and knowledge connect across an organization while respecting enterprise-grade security, governance, permissions, and ethical walls. Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms. That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including: Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies Five-time Top Workplace USA winner Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you. What You’ll Do NetDocuments is seeking a Principal Software Engineer – Intelligent DMS to provide technical leadership across the next generation of our document management platform. This role will help shape the architecture connecting our new web and mobile experiences, design system, extended applications, Microsoft 365 integrations, desktop applications, and AI-powered capabilities into a cohesive platform. You’ll operate as a deeply hands-on technical leader, spending the majority of your time solving complex engineering problems while driving architectural decisions that span multiple teams and products. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, platform engineering, and our AI teams to establish scalable patterns, simplify complex systems, and ensure the experiences we build meet the reliability, security, performance, and usability standards expected by the world’s leading legal organizations. You will: Technical Leadership & Architecture Provide technical leadership across the Intelligent DMS organization, establishing architectural direction and engineering standards that span multiple teams and product surfaces. Lead architectural decisions across web, mobile, backend services, Microsoft 365 integrations, desktop applications, and AI-powered experiences. Define shared technical patterns, component contracts, data models, permission models, and integration approaches that create a cohesive platform. Lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from early product ideation through architecture, implementation, and production. Evaluate architectural trade-offs across scalability, security, performance, usability, maintainability, and speed of delivery. Simplify complex systems and establish technical foundations that enable teams to move faster as the platform evolves. Design & Build Contribute directly to the most complex and consequential areas of the Intelligent DMS platform. Design and build cloud-native applications, microservices, integrations, and customer-facing experiences at enterprise scale. Help architect the next-generation web and mobile applications and the backend services that support them. Establish patterns for integrating AI capabilities such as assistants, summarization, extraction, and intelligent search into everyday document workflows. Lead technical design for Microsoft 365 experiences, including co-authoring and integrations across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Design solutions that maintain correctness, security, and matter-levl permissions across highly concurrent and distributed workflows. Platform Evolution & Modernization Define technical strategies for evolving mature applications and integrations onto the next-generation platform without disrupting critical customer workflows. Establish migration patterns that allow legacy and next-generation experiences to operate effectively during platform transitions. Drive technical coherence across extended applications, desktop clients, sync, import, browser extensions, mobile applications, and Microsoft 365 integrations. Partner with platform and AI engineering teams to establish scalable integration patterns for shared services and capabilities. Set performance and reliability standards for customer-facing applications and drive systemic improvements required to meet them. Cross-Team Technical Leadership Lead technical initiatives involving multiple engineering teams without relying on formal reporting authority. Build alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, Platform, and AI teams around architectural direction and implementation strategy. Translate ambiguous product opportunities into clear technical requirements, architecture, and executable plans. Document architectural decisions and ensure teams understand the reasoning, trade-offs, and standards behind them. Serve as a technical escalation point when teams encounter complex architectural or engineering challenges. Engineering Excellence & Mentorship Mentor engineers across experience levels, including Senior and Staff Engineers, and provide guidance on architecture, system design, and engineering practices. Drive testing, quality, security, and reliability strategies across the Intelligent DMS organization. Establish and maintain architecture documentation, engineering standards, and technical patterns that scale beyond individual projects. Lead design and code reviews for complex or high-impact initiatives. Partner with other Principal Engineers and our Chief Architect to advance technical excellence across the broader engineering organization. Support recruiting and interviewing efforts to help build a high-performing engineering team. Continuous Learning & Innovation Stay current with advancements in AI-native product development, distributed systems, cloud architecture, and modern software engineering. Evaluate emerging technologies and determine where they can meaningfully improve customer experience or engineering effectiveness. Validate new technical approaches with real users and production feedback before scaling them broadly. Champion engineering practices that prioritize simplicity, measurable customer value, and sustainable technical foundations. What You’ll Need to Be Successful Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience operating at the Staff level or above. Proven experience setting architecture and technical direction across multiple products, systems, or engineering teams. Experience leading complex, cross-team technical initiatives without formal authority and driving alignment across engineering stakeholders. Deep expertise in system design, distributed systems, cloud applications, microservices, and enterprise-scale integrations. Strong full stack engineering experience with the ability to work across frontend and backend systems; our technology stack includes C#, .NET, React, and TypeScript. Experience designing and operating cloud-native systems using AWS, Azure, or comparable cloud technologies. Experience translating ambiguous product requirements into clear technical architecture and implementation plans. Demonstrated experience mentoring senior engineers and providing technical guidance across teams. Strong technical writing skills with experience creating architecture documents, design proposals, and technical decision records. What Will Make You Stand Out Experience shipping AI-native product experiences where AI is fundamental to the product workflow. Experience operating multi-tenant enterprise platforms with strict security, compliance, or data residency requirements. Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office add-ins, Microsoft Graph, or co-authoring technologies. Experience modernizing legacy applications while maintaining heavily used production systems and managing complex customer migrations. Experience in legal technology, professional-services SaaS, or other regulated enterprise software environments. Public examples of technical leadership through conference speaking, technical writing, open-source contributions, or architectural patterns adopted by other teams. A track record of leading complex technical initiatives through both successful outcomes and lessons learned from approaches that did not work. What You’ll Love About NetDocuments The People! 90% healthcare premiums company covered HSA company contribution 401(k) match at 4% with immediate vesting Flexible PTO (typically 3 to 4 weeks a year) 10 paid holidays Monthly contributions for life activities & wellness Access to LinkedIn Learning with monthly dedicated time to explore Connection, access, and mentorship from exceptional leaders Growing company with opportunities for advancement Authenticity and accountability from leadership Compensation Transparency The compensation range for this position is $200,000 – $220,000. The posted cash compensation includes on-target earnings. Some roles may qualify for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. Equal Opportunity NetDocuments is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, (including pregnancy), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, military and veteran status, or any other status protected by laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. NetDocuments believes diversity and inclusion among our employees is critical to our success, and we are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.
